page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a KVM-based virtual server driven by a 3.1 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The configuration includes 128 GB of RAM, yielding 4.0 GB per vCPU. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 (F and VNNI), AES, FMA, and BMI2. The instance does not include bundled local storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark testing places the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge within the middle 50% across measured metrics. The processor recorded a multi-core stress-ng score of 30666.35 alongside a single-core score of 1436.68. Synthetic compute workloads yielded a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 29517.51. Memory throughput tests demonstrated read speeds of 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks and 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small blocks, with write performance reaching 48.22 GB/sec. Operational tests yielded 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. Small 135M model LLM text generation achieved 85.62 tokens per second, which decreased to 12.4 tokens per second on a 7B model.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM memory density combined with dedicated high-frequency core allocation delivers a balanced resource profile suitable for general-purpose workloads. The main resource tradeoff is the complete absence of local NVMe storage and hardware GPU acceleration, requiring network-attached storage for stateful services and offloaded acceleration for large-scale AI tasks. This instance profile is well-aligned for software compilation, web application serving, database workloads, and moderate text-processing pipelines where predictable single-thread and multi-thread CPU throughput is required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128 GB of RAM on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU running at 3.1 GHz. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading and features 35 MB of L3 cache, along with AVX-512 and AES vector instruction sets. The server lacks attached local storage and GPU hardware, utilizing a 10 Gbps baseline network interface for external connectivity. In benchmark evaluations, it sits in the middle performance tier, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 11107.0, a PassMark CPU score of 29517.51, and a Redis throughput of 28.91 million SET operations per second. Memory bandwidth reaches 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large reads. This resource configuration fits balanced compute-to-memory applications, web serving, software compilation, and in-memory data operations.
